# CDH Crane Rentals

> cranes, boom trucks, and heavy-lift units with NCCCO-certified operators and

## Services
- [Operated Crane Rental](https://cdhrentals.com/services/operated-crane-rental/): Crane plus NCCCO-certified operator, fuel, insurance, and ongoing maintenance. Our standard rental model.
- [Bare Crane Rental](https://cdhrentals.com/services/bare-crane-rental/): Crane only. You supply the certified operator and assume operational responsibility. Best for long-duration in-house programs.
- [Heavy Lift](https://cdhrentals.com/services/heavy-lift/): Engineered heavy lift execution for refinery, petrochem, LNG, marine, and major structural picks across the Gulf South.
- [Critical Lift Engineering](https://cdhrentals.com/services/critical-lift-engineering/): In-house lift plan engineering for critical picks. Load chart verification, rigging design, route survey, and pre-construction coordination.
- [Refinery Turnaround Crane Services](https://cdhrentals.com/services/refinery-turnaround/): Pre-staged cranes, pre-badged operators, and 24/7 dispatch for refinery and petrochemical turnarounds in the Gulf South.
- [Marine Crane Services](https://cdhrentals.com/services/marine-crane/): Marine-spec cranes for vessel topside picks, dock work, barge handling, and shipyard support across the Gulf Coast.
- [HVAC & Steel Sets](https://cdhrentals.com/services/hvac-and-steel-sets/): Right-sized cranes and the right operators for rooftop HVAC sets, structural steel, and curtain wall picks across Louisiana and Texas.
- [24/7 Emergency Dispatch](https://cdhrentals.com/services/emergency-24-7-dispatch/): Live dispatch around the clock for refinery upsets, storm response, marine emergencies, and urgent commercial picks.

## Industries
- [Refining & Petrochem](https://cdhrentals.com/industries/refining-petrochem/): Pre-badged operators, pre-staged cranes, and turnaround-grade execution at refineries and petrochemical plants across the Gulf South.
- [Marine & Dock](https://cdhrentals.com/industries/marine-and-dock/): Marine-spec cranes for shipyards, terminals, port operations, and dock work along the Gulf Coast.
- [Commercial Construction](https://cdhrentals.com/industries/commercial-construction/): Right-sized cranes for commercial GCs in Lafayette, Baton Rouge, New Orleans, and the Gulf South — HVAC sets, steel, curtain wall.
- [Utilities & Power](https://cdhrentals.com/industries/utilities-and-power/): Substation transformer sets, switchyard work, generation support, and storm response across the Gulf South utility footprint.
- [Emergency Response](https://cdhrentals.com/industries/emergency-response/): Storm response, refinery upsets, marine emergencies, and 24/7 urgent picks across the Gulf South.

## Guides
- [How to Pick the Right Crane Tonnage](https://cdhrentals.com/learn/how-to-pick-the-right-crane-tonnage/): A practical guide to sizing a crane for your pick — load weight, lift radius, pick height, and the 75% rule of thumb.
- [Operated vs Bare Crane Rental](https://cdhrentals.com/learn/operated-vs-bare-rental/): Operated rental is the default for most picks; bare rental fits long-duration in-house programs. Here is how to choose.
- [What NCCCO Certification Means](https://cdhrentals.com/learn/what-nccco-certification-means/): NCCCO is the national certification standard for crane operators. Here is what the test covers, why it matters, and what to ask for.
- [Crane Permits in Louisiana](https://cdhrentals.com/learn/crane-permits-louisiana/): When you need a crane permit in Louisiana, who issues it, and what to expect for road closures and traffic control.
